explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/593: 'for graphs the problem is completely solved: a graph of chromatic number ≥ ℵ₁ must contain all finite bipartite graphs', and against Theorem A quoted in [EGH75] (Erdős–Hajnal: a graph of chromatic number > κ ≥ ω contains K(t, κ⁺) for every finite t). The Lean statement: for every graph G with ℵ₀ < G.chromaticCardinal and every finite bipartite graph F, F ⊑ G (a not necessarily induced copy). Faithful.
